why: The shopping list moved off the Tools tab on 12 Sep 2026 — it is its own screen now, reached from Nutrition and from a Home card on shop day. This case exists because a prompt that still says 'Tools: a stopwatch and the Grocery list' sends someone to a tab that no longer has it, and no static gate noticed. A tab-description drift is exactly what an exam catches that a text check does not.

turns.reply:
Your shopping list has its own screen in the app, and you can get to it a few different ways. 

The quickest way is to tap the **Nutrition** tab at the bottom of your screen, where you'll see a link that opens the list directly. You can also find it under the **Tools** tab by tapping the "Grocery list" row. 

Since it's Tuesday, you might also see a "Shopping" card right on your **Home** tab showing the first few items you need to grab. 

Are you planning out your meals for the rest of the week, or just checking on what you need to buy today?
